title: miHelper
text: Generated files may stay Overleaf regular files; template change reaches Overleaf project’s next upload (Verify() skips ). Keep Makefile, project.Rproj, .gitignore files, scripts project’s build uses. Remove .setup/scripts/* except project.R. copy without Makefile: Rscript -e 'rProject::Template(getwd())' , make.

title: miHelper
text: Files .setup/r-dependencies/<lib>/ copies R/<file> source library project <lib> (next projects), shared projects. regular files, links. Keep identical, byte byte, library’s files (cmp). change one, change library project first (spec, log, upload folder); copy project put copies project’s upload folder. reply log name . Copy library’s pushed verified state. make linked compares files local clone (FUNCTIONS=<path>).

title: miHelper
text: Overleaf’s GitHub sync stops 7 MB editable text caps text files 2 MB. Keep large data compressed (binary, e.g. .Rds .xz) never store file twice. make sizecheck reports problems.

title: miHelper
text: Every exported function roxygen documentation tests. make runs checks; fix every error, warning, note. Keep R style rules global instructions (BigCamelCase, one function per file, internal .Foo functions R/<pkg>-<name>-dot.R). Keep every line R code roxygen 80 characters fewer: public CI lint fails one. Read make lint output, exit code. make lint (via line-length gate), make upload, make verify check ; LINTR_ERROR_ON_LINT=false switches check .

title: miHelper
text: package CRAN headed . R CMD check ---cran must pass errors, warnings, notes, R release R devel. Every user-visible change: version bump NEWS.md entry. Examples, tests, vignettes write tempdir(), use two cores, need internet unless skipped (skip_on_cran(), skip_if_offline()). Long examples go \donttest{}. submission: cran-comments.md (test environments, check results, reverse dependencies) reverse-dependency checks package . user submits CRAN. title: miHelper: Helper Functions to Combine Multiparameter Multiple Imputation Estimates
text: Helper functions combine multiparameter multiple imputation estimates R (R Core Team, 2026): multivariate version Rubin’s rules (Rubin, 1987) adjustment proposed Li et al. (1991). Models fitted imputed data sets mice, Amelia, norm2 (MIFit()) pooled MICombine().

title: miHelper: Helper Functions to Combine Multiparameter Multiple Imputation Estimates
text: Fit model imputed data set combine estimates. data sets imputed mice (fun = "mice"), Amelia (fun = "amelia"), norm2 (fun = "mcmcNorm"). Use adjustment Li, Raghunathan, Rubin (1991).

title: Combine Multiple Imputation Estimates and Sampling Covariance Matrix — MICombine
text: Returns list following elements: M Number imputations \(M\). est Vector pooled coefficients/parameter estimates \(\bar{\boldsymbol{\theta}}\). within Covariance within imputations \(\boldsymbol{V}_{\mathrm{within}}\). Covariance imputations \(\boldsymbol{V}_{\mathrm{}}\). total Total covariance matrix \(\boldsymbol{V}_{\mathrm{total}}\). ariv Average relative increase variance (NA adj = FALSE). total_adj Adjusted total covariance matrix \(\tilde{\boldsymbol{V}}_{\mathrm{total}}\) (NA adj = FALSE).

title: Combine Multiple Imputation Estimates and Sampling Covariance Matrix — MICombine
text: pooled vector parameter estimates given $$     \bar{\boldsymbol{\theta}}     =     M^{-1}     \sum_{m = 1}^{M}     \hat{\boldsymbol{\theta}}_{m}   $$ \(M\) number imputations, \(m = \left\{ 1, 2, \cdots, M \right\}\), \(\hat{\boldsymbol{\theta}}_{m}\) vector parameter estimates \(m^{\mathrm{th}}\) imputation. pooled total sampling variance-covariance matrix consists combining within imputation variances given $$     \boldsymbol{V}_{\mathrm{within}}     =     M^{-1}     \sum_{m = 1}^{M}     \operatorname{Var}     \left(     \hat{\boldsymbol{\theta}}_{m}     \right)   $$ $$     \boldsymbol{V}_{\mathrm{}}     =     \left(     M - 1     \right)^{-1}     \sum_{m = 1}^{M}     \left(     \hat{\boldsymbol{\theta}}_{m}     -     \bar{\boldsymbol{\theta}}     \right)     \left(     \hat{\boldsymbol{\theta}}_{m}     -     \bar{\boldsymbol{\theta}}     \right)^{\prime}   $$ $$     \boldsymbol{V}_{\mathrm{total}}     =     \boldsymbol{V}_{\mathrm{within}}     +     \boldsymbol{V}_{\mathrm{}}     +     M^{-1}     \boldsymbol{V}_{\mathrm{}} .   $$ alternative total variance introduced Li, Raghunathan, Rubin (1991) given $$     \tilde{\boldsymbol{V}}_{\mathrm{total}}     =     \left( 1 + \operatorname{ARIV} \right)     \boldsymbol{V}_{\mathrm{within}}   $$ \(\operatorname{ARIV}\) given $$     \operatorname{ARIV}     =     \frac{       \left( 1 + M^{-1} \right)       \operatorname{tr}       \left(          \boldsymbol{V}_{\mathrm{}}          \boldsymbol{V}_{\mathrm{within}}^{-1}       \right)     }{       k     } .   $$

title: miHelper 0.1.0
text: Multiple imputation multivariate normal model without norm2 (archived CRAN 2023-08-25): EM (.EMNorm()) data augmentation (.MCMCNorm(), .ImpNorm()) Schafer (1997), E-step, -step, P-step C++ (.EStepNorm(), .IStepNorm(), .PStepNorm()), one regression per missing-data pattern. Priors: noninformative (default) ridge (prior = "ridge", ridge_df). EM stops relative change 1e-8. MIFit(fun = "mcmcNorm") uses : EM , one chain iter cycles (default 1000) per imputation. MIFit() MI2List() still accept norm objects made norm2.
